name: Slack
_comment: client_id is empty until the Fused Slack app ships with PKCE and public distribution on; FUSED_RENDER_CONNECT_SLACK_CLIENT_ID fills it, or create your own app from manifest.json (byo). There is no client secret anywhere: PKCE replaces it.
privacy: Sign-in and every call go straight from this computer to Slack. The token stays on this computer. Fused runs no server in this flow.
